title: AtmosTransport runtime configuration
description: Editor schema (Taplo, see .taplo.toml) for the run configs read by scripts/run_transport.jl (config/runs, config/examples). Unknown keys are errors, as in validate_config; topology and binary-capability checks happen in the Julia runtime. test/core/test_config_schema_agreement.jl keeps the keys and choices equal to the parsers'.

input.description: Transport binaries to replay. Choose an explicit list or a folder with an inclusive date range.

binary_paths.description: Transport binaries in run order; ~ and $VAR are expanded. The list is not sorted or checked for date gaps, so give it chronologically.

folder.description: Directory scanned for transport binaries: a file is used when its name carries an 8-digit YYYYMMDD date (or matches file_pattern) within [start_date, end_date]. Every day in the range needs exactly one file; files are read in date order.

start_date.description: First day of the run (inclusive). 00:00 UTC of this day is taken as the start of window 1 and is the time origin of time-varying surface fluxes and observation sampling.

end_date.description: Last day of the run (inclusive). Time-varying surface fluxes are loaded through the end of this day or the last binary window, whichever is later.

file_pattern.description: Optional filename pattern containing exactly one {YYYYMMDD} placeholder.

require_adaptive_substeps.description: Reject binaries that do not carry a per-window adaptive substep schedule.

validate_replay.description: Replay every binary's continuity (stored fluxes reproduce the next window's air mass) when it is opened; for binaries of unknown origin.

expected_nlevel.description: Reject a first binary with a different number of levels.

required_preprocessor_contract.description: Reject a first binary whose header preprocessor_contract differs.

use_gpu.description: Compatibility switch: when true and backend is absent, auto-detect a GPU.

backend.description: Compute backend. Metal requires Float32 numerics.

architecture.description: Compute backend. scripts/run_transport.jl loads the matching GPU package before AtmosTransport.

float_type.description: Floating-point type used by the runtime state.

numerics.description: Floating-point precision of the runtime state.

run.description: Window bounds and state-reanchoring controls. Put advection options in [advection].

start_window.description: First met window to run, a 1-based index within each binary. Runs over several binaries and cubed-sphere runs require 1.

stop_window.description: Last met window to run (inclusive), indexed within each binary; default the binary's last window. Runs over several binaries must cover every window, so set it only for single-binary tests.

air_mass_reset_mode.description: At each new met window, replace the model air mass with the binary's: preserve_tracer_mass keeps tracer masses (exact tracer conservation), preserve_vmr rescales tracer masses to keep mixing ratios, none lets the air mass evolve from the stored fluxes alone.

physics_cadence.description: On binaries with a per-window physics contract: convection and chemistry once per met window, or every advection substep.

prefetch_windows.description: GPU runs with more than one Julia thread: load the next met window on a second thread while the current one runs. false loads each window when it is needed (one device window buffer fewer). Results are identical.

halo_padding.description: Cubed-sphere halo width. Normally inferred from the advection scheme.

tracer_name.description: Legacy single-tracer name used only when [tracers] is absent on structured grids.

scheme.description: upwind: first-order donor cell (the only scheme besides none on reduced-Gaussian grids); slopes: second-order Russell-Lerner slopes; ppm: limited Colella-Woodward (PPM) edges set a second-order Russell-Lerner slope, and with limiter = "cw84" the flux integrates the limited parabola (the complete Colella-Woodward scheme); linrood: cubed-sphere Lin-Rood PPM with FV3 cross terms; none: no advection (surface fluxes are then rejected).

ppm_order.description: scheme = "linrood" only (cubed sphere): 5 (default) or 7 selects the boundary stencil of the PPM reconstruction at cross-panel faces; the in-panel reconstruction is the same FV3 PPM. An error with other schemes.

vertical.description: PPM: same_as_horizontal (default), fv3_kord8 or fv3_kord8_signed (cubed sphere). Lin-Rood: upwind (default), fv3_kord8 or fv3_kord8_signed.

limiter.description: PPM only: monotone, or cw84 for the complete Colella-Woodward scheme.

check_binary_cfl.description: Cubed sphere, scheme = upwind, slopes or ppm: recompute the CFL subcycle count at every step and stop if the binary's substep schedule asks for fewer (slower; for binaries of unknown origin).

advection.description: Advection scheme and its options (without the table: upwind). These keys are no longer read from [run].

kind.description: none; constant (uniform Kz from value); tm5_beljaars_viterbo_local_kz (TM5 local Kz from the binary's pblh, ustar, pbl_hflux, t2m); geoschem_holtslag_boville_vdiff (GEOS-Chem local Kz, also needs the VDIFF sections); geoschem_nonlocal_vdiff (GEOS-Chem non-local PBL mixing with counter-gradient transport, also needs pbl_eflux); tm5_dkg (TM5 interface exchange stored as :dkg). All kinds except none and constant are cubed-sphere only and need those binary sections.

value.description: Constant Kz in m^2 s^-1 when kind = "constant".

surface_flux_boundary.description: Couple the surface source directly to the diffusion boundary condition.

type.description: Legacy selector: rejected without kind, ignored next to it. Use kind.

diffusion.description: Vertical (boundary-layer) diffusion. An absent or empty table means no diffusion; otherwise kind is required.

kind.description: none; cmfmc: GEOS-Chem-style explicit mass-flux scheme from the binary's CMFMC and optional DTRAIN; cmfmc_matrix: the same GEOS rates through the TM5 implicit LU solver; tm5: TM5 (Tiedtke 1989) entrainment/detrainment fields entu, detu, entd, detd with an implicit column solve.

clamp.description: Enable the positivity clamp for the explicit CMFMC scheme.

cloud_base.description: Convective cloud base of kind = "cmfmc": the CMFMC edge, or the archived DQRCU level.

tile_workspace_gib.description: kind = "tm5" or "cmfmc_matrix": memory budget in GiB of the legacy column-tile workspace; a larger budget means fewer kernel launches. The collaborative GPU solver allocates it only when it falls back to the legacy solver.

use_collab_lu.description: kind = "tm5" or "cmfmc_matrix": request the GPU solver with one workgroup per column and the LU factors in shared memory. CPU runs and unsupported Float64 configurations fall back to the legacy full-column solver with a warning; cubed-sphere adjoint runs require false.

lmax_conv.description: kind = "tm5" or "cmfmc_matrix" with use_collab_lu = true: 0 solves the full column; a positive value restricts the convective solve to that many lowest levels. Check the retained depth against the forcing's cloud tops.

n_merge.description: kind = "tm5" or "cmfmc_matrix" with use_collab_lu = true: 1 solves on model levels; a larger value merges that many adjacent layers per super-layer, an approximation that changes vertical mixing and drops up to n_merge-1 top layers of the active depth.

convection.description: Convective transport, applied after advection and diffusion (cadence: run.physics_cadence). The binary must carry the forcing the chosen kind reads.

kind.description: none, or decay: first-order exponential decay of each tracer listed in half_lives_seconds (for example Rn-222). decay without half-lives does nothing.

half_lives_seconds.description: Positive first-order half-life keyed by tracer name.

chemistry.description: Chemistry, applied after advection, diffusion and convection.

tracers.description: Tracer definitions keyed by the output tracer name. Write the initial condition and the surface flux as [tracers.<name>.init] and [tracers.<name>.surface_flux] tables.

output.description: Gridded snapshot output (NetCDF or ATMSNAP binaries) and observation sampling.

init.description: Legacy single-tracer initial condition, used only when [tracers] is absent on structured grids.

level.description: Minimum log level of the run, validation included: warn is concise, debug verbose. Omitted: the current logger's level applies (info for scripts/run_transport.jl).

progress.description: Progress over met windows: a redrawn bar (terminals), one log line every progress_interval_windows windows (batch logs), or none.

progress_interval_windows.description: progress = "lines" only: met windows between progress log lines, counted over the whole run; a line is also written after the last window.

checks.description: Runtime checks of the model state.

nan_check.description: Stop the run with an error when the air mass or a tracer holds a NaN or Inf.

nan_check_interval_windows.description: Check the air mass and tracers for NaN or Inf after every n-th met window, counted over the whole run (across input files); 1 checks every window.

enabled.description: Copy upcoming binaries into dir on a background task and read the copies. A failed copy, or a directory owned by another run, falls back to the source path; false reads the source paths directly.

dir.description: Local staging directory; required when staging is enabled.

lookahead_days.description: Number of binaries after the current one to copy in advance.

keep_behind_days.description: Number of already processed binaries kept in dir before they are removed.

cleanup_on_exit.description: Remove this run's staged copies when the run ends. With false, a later run reuses a copy whose recorded source path, size, timestamps and inode still match.

staging.description: Rolling copy of upcoming input binaries to fast local disk while the run reads them, bounding local use to lookahead_days + 1 + keep_behind_days files. Must be a table even when disabled.

init.description: Initial condition. Without an init table (or flat init keys in this table) the tracer starts at zero.

surface_flux.description: Surface emission or uptake, added to the lowest model layer. Omit it, or set kind = "none", for no flux.

tracer.description: One transported tracer; the table name is the tracer name in the output (for example co2 writes co2, co2_column_mean, ...).

kind.description: uniform: background everywhere; latitude_step (alias lat_step, hemisphere_step): south_value and north_value split at split_lat_deg; bl_enhanced: background plus enhancement in the lowest n_layers (lat-lon only); gaussian_blob: background plus a horizontal Gaussian, equal at all levels; file (alias netcdf, file_field): a lon-lat NetCDF field interpolated to the grid; catrine_co2: file with the CATRINE startCO2 defaults; pressure_layer: one layer per column normalised to total_molecules (cubed sphere); cs_native: a field already on the binary's cube and levels (cubed sphere).

background.description: Dry VMR (mol/mol), default 4.0e-4: the value of uniform, the base of bl_enhanced and gaussian_blob, and the south value of latitude_step when south_value is absent.

enhancement.description: bl_enhanced: dry VMR (mol/mol) added to background in the lowest n_layers model layers; default 1.0e-4.

n_layers.description: bl_enhanced: number of lowest model layers that receive enhancement; default 3, at most the number of levels.

south_value.description: latitude_step: dry VMR (mol/mol) of cells south of split_lat_deg; default background, else 4.0e-4.

north_value.description: latitude_step: dry VMR (mol/mol) of cells at or north of split_lat_deg; default 4.4e-4.

split_lat_deg.description: latitude_step: latitude in degrees north where the step lies; cells whose centre is at or north of it get north_value. Default 0.

lon0_deg.description: gaussian_blob: centre longitude in degrees east; default 0.

lat0_deg.description: gaussian_blob: centre latitude in degrees north; default 0.

sigma_lon_deg.description: gaussian_blob: standard deviation in degrees of longitude (not scaled by cos(latitude)); default 10.

sigma_lat_deg.description: gaussian_blob: standard deviation in degrees of latitude; default 10.

amplitude.description: gaussian_blob: dry VMR (mol/mol) added to background at the centre; default background.

file.description: NetCDF file of the file kinds (file, netcdf, file_field, catrine_co2) and cs_native; ~ and $VAR are expanded. catrine_co2 defaults to ~/data/AtmosTransport/catrine/InitialConditions/startCO2_202112010000.nc.

variable.description: Variable read as dry VMR (mol/mol), without unit conversion. File kinds: a lon-lat-level field, interpolated bilinearly (lat-lon, reduced Gaussian) or conservatively (cubed sphere) and in log pressure when the file has ap, bp and Psurf and another level count; cs_native: (time,) lev, nf, Ydim, Xdim on the binary's cube and levels. catrine_co2 defaults to CO2.

time_index.description: File kinds and cs_native: 1-based index along the variable's time dimension, used when it has one; default 1.

vertical_order.description: cs_native: level order in the file. surface_first (default, GEOS-Chem) is flipped to the model's top-first order; toa_first is copied as is.

clamp_negative.description: cs_native: set negative values to zero.

lowest_layer.description: pressure_layer: true places the tracer in the lowest model layer of every column and ignores psurf_fraction.

psurf_fraction.description: pressure_layer: each column's tracer goes into the layer whose log-pressure midpoint is nearest psurf_fraction times its surface pressure; default 0.5.

total_molecules.description: pressure_layer: total number of tracer molecules in the selected layers, reached with one uniform dry VMR; default 1e22. Other layers start at zero.

initial_condition.description: Initial dry volume mixing ratio (mol/mol) of a tracer, built by kind on the binary's grid and converted to tracer mass with the first window's air mass.

kind.description: A named source, or "file" for a generic NetCDF file.

file.description: NetCDF file on a regular lon-lat grid (cs_native: on the binary's cube). Required for kind = "file" and "cs_native"; the named kinds default to their CATRINE inventory under $ATMOSTRANSPORT_DATA_ROOT/catrine/Emissions.

files.description: Time-varying lmdz_co2 and gridfed_fossil_co2: files whose time slices are joined into one series, for spans across calendar years. Takes precedence over file_pattern and file; all files must share one grid.

file_pattern.description: Time-varying lmdz_co2 and gridfed_fossil_co2: path containing {YYYYMM}, expanded to the twelve months of year (default the run-start year). Used when files is absent.

year.description: Calendar year. For gridfed_fossil_co2 (and kgCO2/month/m2 files) it sets the month lengths that convert monthly totals to rates, otherwise read from the time units or file name; with file_pattern it is the year expanded. Not allowed with several files.

variable.description: Flux variable. Required for kind = "file" and "cs_native"; named kinds default to their inventory variable. Per-second densities are read as kg species m^-2 s^-1; kgC m^-2 s^-1 (times 44/12), kgCO2/month/m2 and annual Tonnes per cell are converted.

time_index.description: Static sources: 1-based slice along the variable's time dimension; default 1, or month for gridfed_fossil_co2 and zhang_rn222. Static lmdz_co2 uses the time mean instead; time-varying sources read every slice.

month.description: Static gridfed_fossil_co2 and zhang_rn222: month (1-12) read when time_index is absent. gridfed_fossil_co2 needs month or time_index; zhang_rn222 defaults to 1.

scale.description: Factor applied to the flux after unit conversion; default 1.0.

molar_mass_kg_mol.description: Molar mass of the species in kg mol^-1, used to convert kg of species to model storage units. Required unless the tracer is named co2, co2_natural, co2_fossil, fossil_co2, sf6 or rn222.

time_varying.description: Cubed sphere only: step through the inventory's time slices, counted from [input].start_date at 00:00 UTC; set start_date (without it the origin depends on how the file's time axis decodes). Supported by lmdz_co2, gridfed_fossil_co2 and cs_native (required there); false uses one static field.

temporal_scheme.description: time_varying = true: stepwise (default) holds each slice from its time stamp to the next, as GEOS-Chem/HEMCO does for CAMS fluxes; linear interpolates between the two bracketing slices at the start of each step; conservative applies the exact time integral of that linear interpolation over each step.

regridding.description: Lat-lon and reduced-Gaussian targets: conservative or bilinear (default). Cubed-sphere targets always regrid conservatively.

surface_flux.description: Surface emission or uptake of one tracer, added to the lowest model layer. Physical fluxes (kg of the species) are converted to model storage units with the tracer's molar mass.

output.description: Runtime snapshot output. Preferred keys are path, hours or cadence_hours, split, and format.

enabled.description: false turns off gridded snapshots; path and snapshot times are then not required. [output.observations] has its own enabled.

format.description: netcdf: NetCDF4 at the run's float type. binary_mmap: ATMSNAP binaries (Float32, every field) converted offline with scripts/postprocess/binary_to_netcdf.jl; cubed sphere only, and fields, deflate_level and shuffle are ignored.

path.description: Snapshot file; ~ and $VAR are expanded. With split = "daily", {date}, {YYYYMMDD} or {day} are substituted, else _<date> is inserted before the extension. A path needs snapshot times (hours = [] for none).

hours.description: Explicit snapshot times in hours since the run start: 0 writes the initial state, other times must be met-window ends. hours = [] writes no snapshots; takes precedence over cadence_hours.

cadence_hours.description: Snapshot interval in hours, from start_hour to stop_hour inclusive: 0 writes the initial state and every positive time must fall on a met-window end. Ignored when hours is set.

start_hour.description: Cadence schedule: first snapshot time in hours since the run start; default 0. Read only with an interval key.

stop_hour.description: Cadence schedule: last snapshot time in hours since the run start (inclusive); default the end of the run.

split.description: AbstractOutputPartition for snapshot and observation files.

oneOf.description: SingleOutputFile: one file for the whole run (aliases one_file, one-file).
DailyOutputFiles: one file per input binary/day, named by {date}/{YYYYMMDD}/{day} or a _<date> suffix (aliases per_day, per-day, day).

shuffle.description: Apply the NetCDF shuffle filter; effective only when deflate_level > 0.

snapshot_hours.description: Legacy alias for output.hours; takes precedence when both are set.

snapshot_interval_hours.description: Legacy alias for output.cadence_hours; takes precedence when both are set.

observation_output.description: Observation sampling ([output.observations] → ObservationOutputSpec). Samples the containing model cell at met-window ends and writes <path>_soundings.nc (point events: satellite soundings, ObsPack records, site time lists) and <path>_sites.nc (hourly station series). Files follow [output].split.

path.description: Output path template. _soundings / _sites is inserted before the extension; {date}, {YYYYMMDD} or {day} are substituted per input binary (day index when the binary name has no date).

time_interpolation.description: How point events are placed in time between met-window ends (AbstractObservationTimeInterpolation).

oneOf.description: LinearWindowInterpolation: blend the air and tracer masses of the two window ends bracketing each event (interp_flag 0; 1 when only one sample exists).
NearestWindowSampling: use the single nearest window end (interp_flag 2).

tracers.description: Tracers to sample (Union{Nothing, Vector{Symbol}}); omit or "all" for every model tracer (nothing). Must exist in [tracers].

write_profile_for_sites.description: Also write full profiles, interface pressures and layer air mass in the _sites file.

layer_height_temperature_kelvin.description: ConstantLayerTemperature used for intake-layer heights. Cubed-sphere binaries with GCHP VDIFF fields use their layer temperature instead (ProfileLayerTemperature).

start_time.description: Run origin, ISO-8601 UTC string or TOML date-time; only used (and then required) when [input].start_date is absent. Must equal start_date at 00:00 when both are given.

deflate_level.description: NetCDF4 deflate level, 0 (none) to 9, of the _soundings and _sites files; compressed variables also get the shuffle filter.

observation_source.description: One [[output.observations.sources]] table; `kind` selects the AbstractObservationSource type.

kind.description: Reader of the requests: oco2_lite (OCO-2/OCO-3 Lite or MIP files), obspack (NOAA ObsPack) or table (your own CSV, TOML or NetCDF list).

oneOf.description: OCO2LiteSource: NASA OCO-2/OCO-3 Lite files or OCO-2 v11 MIP 10-second averages (sounding_id, time, latitude, longitude). Point events only.
ObsPackSource: NOAA ObsPack NetCDF files: per-record point events (mode = "soundings") or station series (mode = "sites").
TableSource: Your own CSV/TOML/NetCDF list of point events or sites (see schemas/observation_sites.schema.json).

path.description: File or template: {YYYYMMDD} or {date}, {YYMMDD}, {YYYY}, {MM}, {DD} are substituted per run day; * and ? wildcards in the file name. A path without date tokens must match.

mode.description: AbstractObservationMode. Required for obspack and table; oco2_lite is always soundings.

oneOf.description: SoundingMode: point events, each sampled once at its own time and intake height (_soundings file).
SiteMode: station series written at met-window ends per site schedule (_sites file; time lists become point events).

quality_filter.description: oco2_lite only (AbstractQualityFilter): which records become point events.

oneOf.description: QualityFlagFilter(quality_variable, quality_flag_max): keep records with flag <= quality_flag_max (Lite files: xco2_quality_flag, 0 = good).

QualityFlagValues(quality_variable, quality_flag_values): keep records whose flag is listed (MIP files: quality_variable = "assimilate_flag", values 0 = not assimilated, 1 = assimilated, 2 = withheld).
NoQualityFilter: keep every record (the OCO-2 v11 MIP co-samples all 10-s averages).

quality_variable.description: oco2_lite with quality_filter = "flag_max" or "flag_values": the integer flag variable to test.

quality_flag_max.description: quality_filter = "flag_max" only: largest accepted flag value.

quality_flag_values.description: quality_filter = "flag_values" only (required there): accepted flag values, e.g. [1].

oneOf.description: SiteCodeGrouping: one site per dataset file and intake height; id = dataset name [+ _<h>magl].
LocationGrouping: one site per rounded (lat, lon, intake); id = <site_code>_<lat>N_<lon>E_<h>magl.
CSVTableFormat: header line, comma-separated, # comments, no quoting; list-valued times use ';'.
TOMLTableFormat: [[soundings]] or [[sites]] arrays of tables; times may be a TOML array.
NetCDFTableFormat: 1-D variables along the record dimension; CF time units.

hours.description: Snapshot times in hours since the run start. 0 writes the initial state; every other time must be a met-window end. Repeated times are an error and times after the run end are skipped with a warning.

tracers.description: Tracers whose fields are written: one name, a list, "all" (default) or "none"; each name must be a tracer of the run.

layers.description: Per-level tracer mixing ratio (<tracer>) for all tracers: full (default), selected (levels only) or none (column fields only). Also the default of air_mass_layers.

levels.description: 1-based model levels (1 = top of the atmosphere) written when layers or air_mass_layers is "selected"; required there.

column_mean.description: Write <tracer>_column_mean, the air-mass-weighted column mean of the dry VMR.

column_mass_per_area.description: Write <tracer>_column_mass_per_area, the column sum of tracer storage (dry VMR times dry-air mass) per cell area in kg m^-2; model storage units, not kg of the species.

air_mass_layers.description: Levels of air_mass and air_mass_per_area: full, selected (levels) or none; defaults to layers.

air_mass.description: Write air_mass, the layer air mass per cell in kg on the binary's mass basis (dry by default).

air_mass_per_area.description: Write air_mass_per_area, the layer air mass divided by cell area (kg m^-2).

column_air_mass_per_area.description: Write column_air_mass_per_area, the column air mass divided by cell area (kg m^-2).

per_tracer.description: Overrides of layers, column_mean and column_mass_per_area keyed by tracer name; each must be a tracer of the run, and unset keys inherit [output.fields].

output_fields.description: Variables written to NetCDF snapshots; the defaults write every field for every tracer. Ignored with format = "binary_mmap".

layers.description: This tracer's per-level mixing ratio: full, selected or none; default [output.fields].layers.

column_mean.description: Write this tracer's air-mass-weighted column-mean dry VMR; default [output.fields].column_mean.

column_mass_per_area.description: Write this tracer's column storage mass per area (kg m^-2); default [output.fields].column_mass_per_area.

tracer_output_fields.description: Output overrides for one tracer; unset keys inherit the [output.fields] values.

layer_selection.description: Levels a field is written at: full (every model level), selected ([output.fields].levels, on a lev_selected dimension) or none (no per-level field).
